name: Dangerous Blind Wife
overview:
Do you really think I'm blind? I just don’t want to expose your lies just yet.

The well-known bestselling blind female writer Lesley unexpectedly gets her eyesight back and finds out that her husband Alfred has been cheating on her and killed her best friend. Her life has also been taken over by the other woman Kate. She decides to hide the truth that she can see again and join forces with the undercover cop Joshua to take revenge.
